standard_prerequisites.name: Transitivity, potency and cumulation of the V-hierarchy
standard_prerequisites.use: Line 892: V_alpha in its successor stage; lines 899-901: at limits, V_alpha in V_beta together with V_beta in V_alpha forces V_beta in V_alpha's own membership chain.

standard_prerequisites.name: Successor and limit hierarchy equations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same unit, the definition of V_alpha by transfinite recursion: V_succ = powerset, V_limit = union
standard_prerequisites.use: Each case opens by unfolding the corresponding equation.

core_obligations: Empty case (proof line 887): V_empty = empty set, self-membership fails visibly.

Successor case (lines 889-894): V_succ in V_succ would put V_succ inside the powerset of V_alpha, i.e. as a subset; together with V_alpha in V_succ that circles back to V_alpha in V_alpha; the converse implication is written in the same paragraph.

Limit case (lines 895-902): self-membership at the limit places V_alpha inside some earlier V_beta; cumulation then gives V_beta in V_alpha in V_beta, contradicting the induction hypothesis at beta; the converse direction closes in one sentence.
proof_roadmap: Unfold powerset at successors and the union at limits.
Transfer a hypothetical self-membership down to an earlier stage.
